scene town2_noon
This town has two halves.
lines.zh: 这座小镇有两半。

lines.en: I’ve familiarized myself with both of them over the X amount of time that I’ve been here.
lines.zh: 我在这儿待了 X 那么久，两半都已经混熟了。

lines.en: And even though I’ve X and X, my heart still X.
lines.zh: 而且就算我已经 X 过、又 X 过，我的心依然 X。

lines.en: And the thought that maybe something special will occur if I place myself where I’m not supposed to be has turned into an irremovable knot in this rope made of X.
lines.zh: 而那个念头——说不定只要把自己放到不该出现的地方，就会发生什么特别的事——已经在这根由 X 搓成的绳子上，打了个解不开的结。

lines.en: I’m tired now. Broken, even.
lines.zh: 现在我累了。甚至坏掉了。

lines.en: And if broken isn’t bad enough- turn my sadness into smiles, even.
lines.zh: 如果坏掉还不够糟的话——那就把我的悲伤也变成笑容吧。

lines.en: Because at least a frown is honest when you’re brave or careless enough to wear one in public. But, once it's flipped on its head, things get a lot more blurry.
lines.zh: 因为至少愁眉苦脸是诚实的——当你在公共场合有那个胆子、或者够不在乎地挂着它的时候。可一旦把它翻过来，事情就模糊多了。

lines.en: I find that, most of the time, people are only smiling because they feel like they’re supposed to. But then you sit down and talk to them and realize they’re not happy at all.
lines.zh: 我发现，大多数时候，人们笑只是因为他们觉得自己该笑。可你坐下来跟他们聊聊，就会发现他们一点也不快乐。

lines.en: So maybe I’m better than others in that regard. Maybe the fact that I {i}can’t{/i} smile is what puts me a step above the rest and gets more feminine fluids all over the bottom of my shirt from hitting it while clothed.
lines.zh: 所以也许在这一方面我比别人强。也许正是我{i}笑不出来{/i}这点，让我比其他人高出一头，也让我的衬衫下摆因为隔着衣服的折腾沾上了更多女人的液体。

lines.en: Maybe I’m only loved because people feel like I’m supposed to be loved.
lines.zh: 也许我被爱，也只是因为别人觉得我该被爱。

lines.en: But it isn’t like that here.
lines.zh: 但这里不是这样。

lines.en: This half of town is honest.
lines.zh: 这一半的小镇是诚实的。

lines.en: And yes, every once in while, my eyes and ears will go bzzzzzt and I’ll reappear somewhere I wasn’t headed to, but that’s {i}fine.{/i}
lines.zh: 而且没错，偶尔我的眼睛和耳朵会嗡——地一下，然后我就重新出现在某个我本来没打算去的地方，不过{i}没关系{/i}。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like I ever have anywhere important to be. And that’s even more true now that I’m basically jobless.
lines.zh: 我是说，反正我也从来没有非去不可的地方。尤其现在，我基本上等于失业了。

lines.en: And if I happen to throw myself on an unsuspecting girl, they’ll be a little less traumatized from the fact that I’m just some stranger instead of the person they’ve entrusted to teach them shit.
lines.zh: 而且就算我撞上一个毫无防备的女孩，她受的惊吓也会小一点，因为我只是个陌生人，而不是那个被托付来教她们东西的人。

lines.en: I slide my hand into my pants and jerk off while I walk down the road because this world is a big sandbox and that’s just what I feel like doing.
lines.zh: 我一边走在路上，一边把手伸进裤子里撸，因为这世界就是个大沙坑，而我就是想这么干。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog17
We make our way into a building I’m extremely familiar with, but the fact that it’s now devoid of the two who {i}truly{/i} called it home makes it feel entirely different.
lines.zh: 我们走进一栋我再熟悉不过的楼，可如今{i}真正{/i}把它当家的人已经不在了，这让它感觉完全变了样。

lines.en: It still smells like rosewater, though. And the stains on the carpet are all right where they were left.
lines.zh: 不过空气里还是玫瑰水的味道。地毯上的污渍也还在原来的地方。

lines.en: : As you’ve probably noticed, I moved some shit around. And got some new shit.
lines.zh: : 你可能看出来了，我挪了些东西。还添了些新东西。

lines.en: : Turns out, there’s a lot of stuff people just leave out on the road if you go out and look on garbage collection days. Stealin’ ain’t necessary at all apparently.
lines.zh: : 结果发现，只要在收垃圾的日子出去转一圈，路边的东西多的是人直接扔掉。看来根本用不着偷。

lines.en: : Thank you for letting me in, Yumi. I get that this must be scary for you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你让我进来，Yumi。我知道这对你来说一定很可怕。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog18

: Okay, can you {i}please{/i} not make it fuckin’ weird? It’s three in the fucking morning and I may have just saved your life. The least you can do is not subtly remind me of that time you assaulted me.
lines.zh: : 行行行，你{i}能不能{/i}别搞得这么恶心？现在是凌晨三点，我可能刚救了你的命。你能不能至少别拐弯抹角地提醒我你袭击过我那件事。

lines.en: : I never meant to do that. You’ve always deserved better. And all I’ve ever done is make things even worse for you.
lines.zh: : 我从来没想过要那样。你一直都该得到更好的。而我做过的所有事，都只是让你更糟。

lines.en: : That’s not...{i}all{/i} you’ve done. Like, you were the one who encouraged me to look into this whole “getting a job” shit and hey, it actually worked out in the end.
lines.zh: : 那不是……你做过的{i}全部{/i}。比如，当初就是你说让我去试试「找工作」这事儿，嘿，最后还真成了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be great.
lines.zh: : 我相信你会做得很好的。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog19
: God! How are you somehow even {i}creepier{/i} now? The fuck’s been going on all this time? And what was all that shit about you {i}losing something?{/i}
lines.zh: : 天啊！你怎么现在反而{i}更 creepy{/i} 了？这段时间到底发生了什么？还有你说你{i}失去了什么{/i}，那到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Fuck did you lose? Cause it sure as hell wasn’t Chika. Know that for sure because the girl turned into a fuckin’ basket case while you were gone.
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底失去了什么？反正肯定不是 Chika。这点我敢肯定，因为你不在的这段时间，那丫头整个人都崩了。

lines.en: : It was another girl.
lines.zh: : 是另一个女孩。

lines.en: : {i}Another{/i} one? Did she like-
lines.zh: : {i}又{/i}一个？她是不是——

lines.en: : She died.
lines.zh: : 她死了。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog20
: She-
: I really don’t want to say any more about it. But please don’t tell anyone else. You’re the first girl I’ve just flat-out admitted this to.
lines.zh: : 我真的不想再多说了。但请别告诉别人。你是第一个我这么直接承认这事的女孩。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. You’ve invited me into your home and all I’ve done is make things more depressing.
lines.zh: : 对不起。你请我进了你的家，而我做的却只是让气氛更压抑。

lines.en: : You do that by just existing. The shit you just told me doesn’t have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 你光是存在着就有这效果。你刚告诉我的那些跟这个没关系。

lines.en: : And this probably ain’t gonna do anything, but...I’m sorry. That you had to go through that. I won’t say shit about how long you’ve been gone anymore. I get it now.
lines.zh: : 而且这话大概也没什么用，但是……我很抱歉。你不得不经历这些。我不会再提你消失多久的事了。我现在明白了。

lines.en: : I really loved her, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我真的很爱她，Yumi。

lines.en: : I know how this must sound to you as someone who-
lines.zh: : 我知道这对你来说听起来会是什么感觉，作为一个——

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog21
: Yeah, just...leave it at that, if you can. Shit’s hard enough for me without having to hide from my best friend that the dude she thinks she’s in love with loved somebody else.
lines.zh: : 行了，就……到此为止吧，行吗？我自己的事已经够难了，还得瞒着我最好的朋友，说她以为自己爱上的人爱的是别人。

lines.en: : Chika too. Maybe. I think. I’m not sure. I’m not sure about anything. I’m confused. I’m so confused. I don’t know what to do.
lines.zh: : 也许 Chika 也是。我想。我不确定。我什么都不确定。我很混乱。我太混乱了。我不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog22
: Sit down, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 坐下吧，Sensei……

lines.en: : I’ll, like...make some tea or some shit...
lines.zh: : 我去……泡点茶什么的……

lines.en: scene black
scene yuminightfrog23
: So...sucks your vacation ain’t been much of a vacation at all. Least when I got kicked out of school, I got to wander around and eat shit.
lines.zh: : 所以说……你那个假期的确算不上什么假期，真惨。至少我被学校开除的时候，还能到处晃悠吃点东西。

lines.en: : And I got spoon-fed by my niece. I’m sure it would have been a blast if I was conscious for any of it.
lines.zh: : 而我被我侄女一勺一勺地喂着。我要是清醒着，那肯定爽翻了。

lines.en: : So that shit about her takin’ good care of you wasn’t just somethin’ you said to appease her since she was, like...right there and shit?
lines.zh: : 所以你说她把你照顾得很好那套，不只是因为……她就站在旁边什么的，你为了哄她才说的？

lines.en: : Is that how it looked to all of you?
lines.zh: : 在你们所有人眼里是那样的？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know what everybody else thinks. I just had a hard time believin’ you’d be that okay with someone so...well, fucking insane.
lines.zh: : 别人怎么想我他妈的哪知道。我只是很难相信你能跟那么……呃，那么疯的人相处得那么好。

lines.en: : She {i}is{/i} insane. But she’s like that because of me.
lines.zh: : 她{i}是{/i}疯。可她变成这样是因为我。

lines.en: : You know, it might sound weird, but the two of you are a lot alike in the fact that she had to raise herself. Just, instead of her parents not being there for her out of choice, they were taken away.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，听着可能有点怪，但你俩有一点很像——她也是自己把自己拉扯大的。只不过她父母不是自己选择不在，而是被夺走了。

lines.en: : And I was never able to fill their shoes. Even tonight, I’m proving that I {i}can’t{/i} fill their shoes by being {i}here{/i} at 3:00 AM while she just lies there in bed.
lines.zh: : 而我从来没能取代他们。就连今晚也是，凌晨三点我在{i}这儿{/i}，而她只是躺在床上，这恰恰证明了我{i}取代不了{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m sure it wasn’t easy. But I also ain’t sure that excuses tellin’ people she’s gonna take their organs and shit.
lines.zh: : 我相信那不容易。但我也不确定这就能成为她跟人说要挖他们器官的理由。

lines.en: : It doesn’t. She needs help. But how am I supposed to help her when I’m {i}like this?{/i}
lines.zh: : 不能。她需要帮助。可我自己都{i}这副样子{/i}，还怎么帮她？

lines.en: : Not sure if you can, dude. You’ve gotta take care of yourself before worryin’ about anybody else. That’s the only way to survive.
lines.zh: : 不知道你能不能，老兄。你得先照顾好自己，才有资格操心别人。这是活下去的唯一办法。

lines.en: : That’s the only way {i}we{/i} know how to survive. But there are other ways, I’m sure of it.
lines.zh: : 这是{i}我们{/i}唯一会的活法。但我敢肯定，一定还有别的活法。

lines.en: : Look at Noriko. Or Futaba. Or Touka. We’re surrounded by selfless people who help others before themselves and they’re all happier than {i}we{/i} are, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 看看 Noriko。或者 Futaba。或者 Touka。我们身边全都是先人后己的无私的人，而他们比{i}我们{/i}快乐，不是吗？

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog24
: Stop askin’ me about other people, dude. I don’t know shit about other people. But I’m hard-pressed to think Futaba’s happy at all after all the shit I’ve said to her.
lines.zh: : 别再问我别人的事了，老兄。别人怎么样我一点都不知道。不过我很难相信 Futaba 在听了我说的那些话之后还会快乐。

lines.en: : She has issues, yeah. A ton of them. And maybe I only think she’s happy because I don’t understand her. But {i}still...{/i}there’s gotta be more than this.
lines.zh: : 她有问题，没错。一大堆。也许我只是因为不懂她，才觉得她快乐。但{i}即便如此{/i}……总该有比这更多的东西吧。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog25
: I just want to wake up one day and think to myself, “I don’t want to go back to sleep.”
lines.zh: : 我只想有朝一日醒来，能对自己说：「我不想再睡回去了。」

lines.en: : And I’m at a point right now where that sounds more impossible than ever before, Yumi. What if nothing just ever feels good again?
lines.zh: : 而我现在正处在这样一个点上——这听起来比以往任何时候都更不可能，Yumi。要是再也不会有什么让我感觉好起来了，怎么办？

lines.en: : Man...never in a million years would I have thought I’d prefer the {i}old{/i} you. I’ve got no clue what the fuck I’m supposed to say to any of this.
lines.zh: : 老兄……我做梦也没想到自己会更喜欢{i}以前{/i}那个你。我他妈完全不知道该对你说的这些回什么。

lines.en: : I know. And I’m sorry. You’re just a teenage girl and I’m dumping thousands if not millions of years worth of problems on you. But I don’t need an answer to any of them, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我知道。对不起。你只是个十几岁的女孩，而我却把几千年、甚至几百万年的问题往你身上倒。但我不需要你给任何答案，Yumi。

lines.en: : I get it. Sometimes just talking helps. Chika’s said shit like that to me before. Apparently I ain’t great at listening, though.
lines.zh: : 我懂。有时候只是说出来就好了。Chika 以前也跟我说过类似的话。看来我不太擅长倾听。

lines.en: : I disagree.
lines.zh: : 我不同意。

lines.en: : In fact, I think you’re an amazing listener.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得你是个很棒的倾听者。

lines.en: : I think you’re an amazing {i}person.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是个很棒的{i}人{/i}。

lines.en: : {b}AND I CAN’T WAIT TO FUCK YOUR DELINQUENT, LITTLE HOLE WITH MY BIG, PROTAGONIST COCK.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}而且我等不及要用我这根主角的大鸡巴操你这个不良少女的小洞了。{/b}

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog26
scene yuminightfrog26
: I didn’t...
lines.zh: : 我没……

lines.en: : That wasn’t...
lines.zh: : 那不是……

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog27
: I didn’t mean to say that. That really wasn’t-
lines.zh: : 我不是想说那个。那真的不是——

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : I get it by now.
lines.zh: : 我现在已经明白了。

lines.en: awwwww, darn it.
lines.zh: awwwww，真可惜。

lines.en: i thought that would win her heart.
lines.zh: 我还以为这能赢得她的心呢。

lines.en: {i}Shut up.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}闭嘴。{/i}

lines.en: : And it ain’t just a {i}you{/i} thing either, apparently.
lines.zh: : 而且看来也不只是{i}你{/i}一个人这样。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Ramen girl’s like that too. Saying...random irrelevant shit outta nowhere.
lines.zh: : 拉面女也那样。会突然冒出些……随机又不相干的话。

lines.en: : Went out to Tojo’s the other night and it got so out of hand that I wound up just throwing my money on the counter and bouncing before it got any weirder.
lines.zh: : 前几天晚上我去 Tojo’s，结果越闹越离谱，我最后直接把钱扔在台子上就跑了，免得更尴尬。

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog28
: She never told me she was gonna fuck me, though. So I like whatever she’s got more.
lines.zh: : 不过她可没说要操我。所以我更喜欢她那套。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo too?...
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 也是？……

lines.en: : What was she saying?
lines.zh: : 她都说了什么？

lines.en: : Just random questions and shit at first. What do you think of this specific date? How do you take your coffee? What kind of pajamas would you bring to a sleepover?
lines.zh: : 一开始只是些随口的问题。你觉得某个特定的日子怎么样？你咖啡怎么喝？你要是去别人家过夜会带什么睡衣？

lines.en: : But then the weird shit started.
lines.zh: : 然后怪事就开始了。

lines.en: : How much can you see with your eyes closed?
lines.zh: : 你闭着眼睛能看见多少？

lines.en: : How much can you fit in a cup?
lines.zh: : 一个杯子里能装得下多少？

lines.en: : What is it you keep in your pocket?
lines.zh: : 你口袋里一直揣着什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk4
: {i}What color is the sky at the end of the world?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}世界尽头的天空是什么颜色？{/i}

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please take your time looking over the menu and-
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。请慢慢看菜单，然后——

lines.en: scene yuminightfrog29
: Tori shio ramen.
lines.zh: : 鸟盐拉面。

lines.en: scene black
: Please wait one moment.
lines.zh: : 请稍等。

lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}她主动提出让你留宿一晚。{/i}

lines.zh: {i}你拒绝了，免得一不小心把她弄怀孕。{/i}
